company.description: Merion Residential is committed to providing residents with a simplistic, hassle-free rental experience, owners and investors a solid return on their investment, and our employees a stable work environment and equal opportunity for learning and professional growth. Our communities are ideal for anyone and perfectly situated in the best neighborhoods. Our homes offer all the luxury and convenience one could desire. When you consider the wide array of community features available, you too will soon realize that Merion Residential properties truly are “Simply Apartment Living at its Best”. Whether you enjoy spending your time outdoors to foster a healthy, active lifestyle, or prefer relaxing at home to escape the busyness of everyday life, Merion Residential’s apartment communities offer the best of both worlds. Our communities feature unparalleled amenities designed with their residents in mind. Enjoy features such as bocce ball courts, fishing docks, cozy gas firepits, and heated salt-water pools. Our communities boast state of the art indoor and outdoor fitness centers, electric vehicle charging stations, yoga studios, resident lounges with coffee bars, and upscale outdoor kitchens. At every property, you will find our friendly and passionate leasing teams ready to assist you in making your apartment your home, as well as a responsive, on-site maintenance team, all eager to make your experience “Simply Apartment Living at its Best.”
company.name: Merion Residential

company.description: We began developing our first apartment building in the Bay Area in 1965. It was a garden apartment building with roomy floor plans, great landscaping, lakes, and a waterfall. Today, we've grown to over 13,000 apartments in and around the SF Bay Area, Seattle, and Portland. And that very first apartment building? It's still in our portfolio. To us, it represents our deep commitment to place-making investments inside and out to make your home feel charming, welcoming, inspiring, and enduring. When it says Prometheus on the door, you will always find friendly people and amazing neighborhoods, all with unique stories to tell. We are a B corporation, part of a group of companies that meets the highest standards for using business as a force for good. We have more than 500 Prometheans, and have a home office in San Mateo, with satellite offices in Portland, Oregon and in the Bay Area. We are a vertically integrated company with four main core competencies in-house: acquisitions/investments, development, value-add renovations and operations/property management. Prometheus has a long history of award-winning approaches to what we do, receiving over 100 awards for design and excellence including Fortune Magazine’s list of 100 Best Small & Medium Companies, the 100 Best Workplaces for Women and the Best Places to Work in the Bay Area.
company.name: Prometheus

company.description: Morgan Group ("Morgan") is a vertically integrated, 3rd generation family business that invests in multifamily housing through development and acquisitions in high growth US markets.
